sources.entry: Signals CLI - Intent signal monitoring. Track LinkedIn engagers, keyword posters, job changers, funding events. JSON output for agent pipelines. npm i -g signals-sortlist-cli

summary.one_liner: A command-line client for the Max lead-intelligence API that lets developers and AI agents create monitoring subscriptions and pull discovered leads as JSON.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a CLI ("Max CLI") for the Max API, which monitors sources such as LinkedIn and funding databases for new leads. It covers browsing a read-only catalog of signal types, and managing businesses (including creating one from a website with an auto-generated Ideal Customer Profile). It also covers creating, pausing, resuming and deleting subscriptions, which are activated signals with a specific config. Leads found by subscriptions can be listed, fetched and soft-deleted. Webhooks can be registered to receive HTTP POSTs with optional HMAC-SHA256 signatures when new leads appear. All output is JSON, intended for jq or agent use.
use_cases: track people engaging with a company's LinkedIn page
pull new leads into an automated agent pipeline
get real-time alerts when new leads are found via webhook
monitor keyword posters or job changers as sales signals
manage multiple businesses and their ideal customer profiles from the terminal
notable: JSON output from every command, designed for jq and AI agents
Installable as an agent skill via npx skills add sortlist/max-cli (SKILL.md)
Business-scoped subscriptions, leads and webhooks, with a --business flag
Pause and resume subscriptions without deleting them
API key can be set via MAX_API_KEY or saved with max login
caveats: Requires a Max API key from the dashboard; API keys are scoped to a team
API rate limit is 60 requests per minute
The README does not say what pricing or plan limits apply
keywords: track who engages with my company
get notified about new sales leads
